project.title: Pomodoro
project.description: A Pomodoro app is designed to boost productivity using the Pomodoro Technique, also available in Android/Apple at https://snack.expo.dev/@chiaangyong1/pomodoro-app

project.title: CrazyAuction
project.description: CrazyAuction is a B2C e-commerce service that revolutionizes online shopping with an innovative auction bidding system. We have developed an enterprise-scale software solution to support this unique auction experience.

project.title: Accessible Tic Tac Toe
project.description: The Accessible Tic-Tac-Toe features a real-time, multiplayer web application built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB, designed to be fully accessible, including support for screen readers and voice command functionality.

project.title: Treasure Chope
project.description: Treasure Chope is a sustainable platform that connects restaurants with surplus food to consumers seeking diverse and affordable meal options, effectively reducing food waste and supporting local businesses.
